about_short_description.short_description: Veradigm is a data systems and services company that provides healthcare information technology solutions.

product.name: Veradigm Suite
product.description: An integrated set of healthcare technology solutions for independent practices, covering clinical workflows, practice operations, revenue management, patient engagement, and resource management.

product.name: EHR Software
product.description: An ambulatory electronic health record platform for clinical documentation, patient information management, and healthcare workflow support.

product.name: Veradigm Payer Analytics
product.description: Analytics and workflow solutions for health plans covering risk adjustment, quality management, utilization, health equity, submissions, and payer-provider collaboration.

product.name: Real-World Data Solutions
product.description: De-identified ambulatory EHR and linked claims data products prepared for healthcare research, outcomes analysis, and real-world evidence generation.

product.name: Real-World Evidence Services
product.description: Research services that use healthcare data to conduct retrospective and prospective studies for life sciences and other healthcare organizations.

product.name: Veradigm Real-World Evidence Analytics Platform
product.description: A self-service analytics platform for analyzing real-world healthcare data and producing evidence for research and healthcare decision-making.
